paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Abba said in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, Shabbat 113, end of b. Asheri reads Rabbi Chiyya bar Ashi in Rabbi Yochanan’s name; Ein Yaakov has bar Adda (see there). Rabbi Abbahu said, “This is Rav Acha’s statement” (I did not find it). He objected to Rabbah, Menachot 84, beginning of b. Rav Chisda, his son-in-law—requires examination there. He spoke to Rav Ashi, Menachot 5b: apparently the early Rav Ashi. He spoke to Rava, Zevachim 4b.
